summary: US Central Command launched powerful strikes against Iran, targeting the IRGC naval base in Sirik, after Iranian forces attacked three commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz with short-range missiles. Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island and in Bandar Abbas, while Iranian state media confirmed the funeral of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. Israel eliminated two senior Hamas commanders in Gaza and uncovered a Hezbollah weapons cache inside a civilian home in southern Lebanon.
key_points: US CENTCOM announced launching powerful strikes against Iran in response to Iranian attacks on three commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @shin_persian/7451)

Iranian forces attacked at least three commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz, including a Saudi tanker and a Qatari gas tanker, using short-range missiles and damaging vessels without casualties. (Source: @N12chat/216383, @inon_yttach/9293, @rodast_omiddana/74857)
Explosions struck the IRGC naval base in Sirik, Hormozgan Province, and Qeshm Island, with Iranian media reporting US bombardment. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/375138, @shin_persian/7455)
Iranian state media confirmed the funeral procession for Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, indicating his death. (Source: @presstv/197458, @naya_foriraq/81474)

IDF and Shin Bet eliminated two senior Hamas commanders in Gaza: Nukhba squad commander Ahmed Yahya Ibrahim Batsh in northern Gaza and military intelligence commander Hamouda Abu Daka in southern Gaza. (Source: @idf_telegram/24546)

Israeli forces in southern Lebanon's Talousa village uncovered Hezbollah weapons caches inside a civilian bedroom, including RPG launchers, anti-tank missiles, explosives, and Hezbollah flags. (Source: @New_security8200/202258)

Qatar formally protested to Iran after its tanker was targeted near the Strait of Hormuz, condemning the attack as a serious violation of international maritime security and global energy supplies. (Source: @VahidOnline/76807)
The US Treasury revoked the license for Iranian crude oil exports, triggering a surge in oil prices. (Source: @naya_foriraq/81450, @kianmeli1/88451)

sections.executive_summary: US Central Command initiated powerful strikes against Iran, hitting the IRGC naval base in Sirik, following Iranian missile attacks on three commercial vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian media report explosions at Qeshm Island and Bandar Abbas, while confirming the funeral of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei. Simultaneously, Israel conducted targeted killings of Hamas commanders in Gaza and exposed Hezbollah weapon storage in Lebanese civilian homes.

points: US CENTCOM confirmed launching powerful strikes against Iran in retaliation for IRGC attacks on three commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, with Iranian media reporting the IRGC naval base in Sirik, Hormozgan Province, was bombed. (Source: @shin_persian/7451, @rasedal3ado138e/375138)

IRGC fired at least two short-range missiles at two commercial ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Monday evening, damaging both vessels but causing no casualties; a US official stated Iran also launched drones that were shot down. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74857, @VahidOnline/76804)

Five additional explosions were heard on Qeshm Island in Hormozgan Province at 21:21 UTC, and six new explosions reported in Bandar Abbas, amid ongoing US strikes and Iranian air defense activity. (Source: @shin_persian/7455, @rasedal3ado138e/375144)

Iranian state media confirmed the funeral procession for Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, with mourners gathering at the Imam Ali shrine in Najaf, Iraq, and the Iranian president traveling to the site. (Source: @presstv/197458, @naya_foriraq/81474, @naya_foriraq/81476)

Iran's Defense Ministry spokesman vowed a strong response to any aggression, while the US Treasury revoked the license for Iranian crude oil exports, causing oil prices to surge. (Source: @presstv/197469, @naya_foriraq/81450, @kianmeli1/88451)

A US official described Iranian attacks in the past 12 hours as 'aggressive' and a 'direct violation of the MOU' signed less than three weeks ago, putting the ceasefire understanding at risk of collapse. (Source: @VahidOnline/76804, @VahidOnline/76797)

Axios reported IRGC attacked a third commercial ship in the Strait of Hormuz, and a senior US official indicated a possible US military response in Iran on the evening of the attacks. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4665, @pkpoi/143164)

IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Hamas Nukhba squad commander Ahmed Yahya Ibrahim Batsh in northern Gaza and military intelligence commander Hamouda Abu Daka in southern Gaza, both involved in planning attacks against Israeli forces. (Source: @idf_telegram/24546)

Brigade 769 under Division 91 continues operations in the southern Lebanon security zone; in Talousa village, forces uncovered Hezbollah weapons caches inside a civilian bedroom including RPG launchers, anti-tank missiles, explosives, RPG rockets, vests, helmets, and Hezbollah flags. (Source: @New_security8200/202258, @idf_telegram/24547)

Prime Minister Netanyahu stated at Haifa naval base that the Israeli Navy's goal is to secure shipping lanes and maritime trade freedom, amid escalating Strait of Hormuz tensions. (Source: @inon_yttach/9297)
A military exercise is scheduled for Wednesday morning in the Golan Heights, with expected explosions and troop movements; IDF clarified no security incident is anticipated. (Source: @N12chat/216392)

Netanyahu told CNN that selling F-35s to Turkey would upset the Middle East balance and he would not do it, while Trump announced lifting CAATSA sanctions on Turkey and Erdogan claimed a US promise to sell five F-35s. (Source: @amitsegal/62843, @yediotnews25/132369, @inon_yttach/9295)
Two people were seriously wounded, one later died, in a shooting in Jadeidi-Makr; police indicated a criminal background. (Source: @N12chat/216384, @N12chat/216387)

IDF and Shin Bet conducted targeted killings of two senior Hamas operatives in Gaza: Nukhba squad commander Ahmed Yahya Ibrahim Batsh in the northern Strip and military intelligence commander Hamouda Abu Daka in the southern Strip. (Source: @idf_telegram/24546)

IDF forces remain deployed in Gaza per the agreement and continue to act against immediate threats; the eliminated commanders were actively planning terror attacks against Israeli troops. (Source: @idf_telegram/24546)

Israeli Brigade 769, operating under Division 91 in the southern Lebanon security zone, discovered a Hezbollah weapons cache inside a civilian bedroom in Talousa village, containing RPG launchers, anti-tank missiles, explosives, RPG rockets, vests, helmets, and Hezbollah flags. (Source: @New_security8200/202258, @idf_telegram/24547)

IDF stated it will continue to operate to remove threats to its forces and will not allow Hezbollah to endanger Israeli civilians, releasing documentation of the seized weapons. (Source: @New_security8200/202258)
Explosions were reported near a Damascus hotel where French President Emmanuel Macron is staying, though no further details on casualties or damage were provided. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4655)
Clashes erupted behind Jabal Tuz Khurmatu in Kirkuk Governorate, northern Iraq, indicating ongoing instability in the area. (Source: @naya_foriraq/81482)

Iranian President was seen heading to the Imam Ali shrine in Najaf, Iraq, amid funeral processions for Ayatollah Khamenei, with Iraqis gathering to receive the body. (Source: @naya_foriraq/81476, @naya_foriraq/81470)

Qatar summoned the Iranian chargé d'affaires and delivered a formal protest note condemning the targeting of a Qatari tanker near the Strait of Hormuz as a serious violation of international maritime security, a direct threat to global energy supplies, and a breach of international law. (Source: @VahidOnline/76807)
The Saudi Foreign Ministry confirmed Iran attacked a Saudi tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz earlier in the day. (Source: @N12chat/216383, @pkpoi/143172)
Oil prices surged minutes after the US announced the reinstatement of sanctions on Iranian crude oil exports. (Source: @New_security8200/202268, @kianmeli1/88451)

President Trump announced the lifting of CAATSA sanctions on Turkey, which had blocked F-35 purchases due to Turkey's S-400 acquisition; Erdogan claimed the US promised to sell five F-35s. (Source: @yediotnews25/132371, @yediotnews25/132369, @inon_yttach/9295)

IRGC fired at least two short-range missiles at two commercial ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz, damaging both vessels without casualties; one identified as a Saudi tanker, another as a Qatari gas tanker. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74857, @N12chat/216383, @inon_yttach/9293)
